notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.6
notes.content:
[b]Enhancement System[/b]
[list]
[*] A system has been added that allows units to be enhanced or the game's difficulty to be reduced through repeated play.
[/list]

[b]Balance Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] The amount of food obtained from defeating zombies has been increased across all difficulty levels.
[*] The probability of Tier 2 units appearing in Level 1 supply crates has been increased.
[*] The probability of units without combination formulas appearing in supply crates has been increased.
[/list]

[b]Convenience[/b]
[list]
[*] Various actions such as unit synthesis, deployment, and movement can now be performed while the game is paused.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.5
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where arrows were not displayed on the Synthesis Chart.
[*] Added a feature to check the Synthesis Chart on the reward screen of supply crates.
[*] Improved scrolling with the mouse wheel in the codex menu for smoother navigation.
[*] Adjusted the number and spawn intervals of bomb zombie groups in the early part of Chapter 2.
[/list]

notes.title: New Unit Update v.1.0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Update Notes[/h1]

[b]New Units[/b]
[list]
[*] 10 new units have been added.
[*] Various new units, such as Ice Tank, Mafia, Samurai, and Ninja, are now available.
[/list]

[b]New Synergies[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new synergies have been added.
[/list]

[b]Balance Adjustments[/b]
[list]
[*] The maximum default deployment limit for Easy difficulty has been increased from 10 to 12.
[*] The maximum default deployment limit for Normal difficulty has been increased from 10 to 11.
[*] The attack power of some melee units has been reduced, and they now attack all zombies within range.
[/list]

[b]Recruitment[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved the recruitment system to reduce the likelihood of the same unit appearing repeatedly.
[/list]

[b]Supply Drops[/b]
[list]
[*] The spawn interval of supply planes has been shortened. Supply planes will now appear more frequently.
[*] Duplicate units will no longer appear in the three options of supply drops.
[*] The chance of obtaining higher-tier units from supply drops has been increased.
[*] Tier 1 units will no longer appear as rewards in Tier 2 (green) or higher supply drops.
[/list]

[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The construction mode can now be closed using the ESC key.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where moving to the opposite direction after reaching the edge of the screen with the WASD keys was not possible.
[*] Corrected some inaccurate translation texts.
[*] Modified the retreat text for units to be distinct from the demolition text for walls.
[*] Fixed an issue where pausing with the spacebar was not possible while game start or rocket construction guide texts were displayed.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.3 - Hotfix
notes.content:
[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where units would disappear in certain situations, permanently occupying population count and deployment space.
[*] Fixed an issue where the "Return to Lobby" button required being pressed twice to function.
[*] Fixed an issue where some language settings would default to English when starting the game.
[*] Fixed an issue where the attack detection for certain melee units did not work correctly when attacking in the up or down directions.
[/list]

[b][Convenience Improvements][/b]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to view the synthesis chart from the pause screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.2
notes.content:
[b][Balance Adjustments][/b]
[list]
[*] The range of Hunter units has been increased from 2 to 3.
[*] The attack power of pickaxe-wielding zombies has been reduced by 20%.
[*] The number of some enemies in Chapter 1 on Easy difficulty has been reduced.
[*] The number of some early-stage enemies in Chapter 2 on Easy and Normal difficulties has been reduced.
[/list]

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where units could not be placed on empty tiles after swapping the positions of a moving unit and another unit.
[/list]

[b][Quality of Life Improvements][/b]
[list]
[*] The UI has been improved to allow players to check the battlefield while paused.
[*] Some pop-ups can now be closed using the Esc key.
[*] Players can now pause the game by pressing the Spacebar when no other pop-ups are active.
[*] Hints for Chapter 2 have been added.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v.1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Quality of Life Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*] The settings menu is now accessible during game pause.
[*] Camera movement speed has been increased.
[*] Camera zoom speed has been increased.
[*] 
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where windowed mode/resolution settings were not saved properly.
[*] Fixed a bug where certain characters in chapter descriptions would appear corrupted.
[*] Fixed an issue where chapter description text exceeded the display area in some languages.
[/list]

notes.title: DEFENSURIVOR is finally released!
notes.content:
DEFENSURIVOR is finally released!

The full version includes three chapters, three difficulties for each chapter, 22 challenges, and supports Steam Cloud storage.

Each of the three chapters has its own characteristics. Come up with a defensive strategy to match the features of the chapter!

In addition, many bugs found in the demo version have been fixed.

notes.title: DEFENSURVIVOR Launch Delay Announcement
notes.content:
Unexpected issues have arisen during the Steam release process of DEFENSURVIVOR, causing a delay in its launch.
We are working hard to release the game as soon as possible.

We kindly ask for your patience as we finalize the official release of DEFENSURVIVOR..

notes.title: DEFENSURVIVOR Demo Updated!
notes.content:
DEFENSURVIVOR Demo Updated!

DEFENSURVIVOR demo has been newly updated!
We have implemented several improvements based on the valuable feedback from players during the previous demo period.

[b]Key Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Difficulty Adjustment[/b]: Three difficulty levels—Easy, Normal, and Hard—have been added to provide a more diverse gameplay experience.
[*] [b]Timer Mechanism Change[/b]: To make it easier to track the survival goal, the timer now counts down from 15:00 to 00:00, instead of counting up from 00:00 to 15:00.
[*] [b]Improved Accessibility[/b]: A new button has been added to take you directly to the Steam store page.
[/list]

Download the DEFENSURVIVOR demo now and experience the new changes firsthand!
Your feedback plays a crucial role in enhancing the game’s quality.
We appreciate your continued interest and support. Thank you!

notes.title: Official Release Date Announcement and Demo Termination Notice
notes.content:
Official Release Date Announcement and Demo Termination Notice

DEFENSURVIVOR is scheduled for official release on December 9, along with additional stages, artifacts, and balance adjustments.

Additionally, as part of the preparation for the official release, the demo version of DEFENSURVIVOR will be terminated starting in November.
Please be mindful when playing the demo.

Thank you.

notes.title: Patch notes Demo 0.9.5
notes.content:
[h1]Balance[/h1]
[list]
[*] Future synergy effect buff
[list]
[*] You can now gain benefits at 1/2/3 synergy levels, with a wider area of effect and more frequent strikes.
[*] The 3rd level synergy requires acquiring an artifact.
[/list][/list]
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Frost Flamethrower was not functioning correctly
[*] Improved unit targeting system
[list]
[*] Medics could heal allies even if they were outside of attack range.
[/list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the synergy UI would not display if there were no synergy units, even when synergy was obtained through artifacts
[*] Fixed an issue where data such as attack speed was read incorrectly in certain countries
[list]
[*] Abnormally recognized stats have been corrected.
[/list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the close button did not work in some unit entries in the compendium
[/list]
